strongest_angle: A coalition of major labor unions has formally petitioned a federal court to reject OpenAI's request for a categorical fair use exemption regarding the training of AI models on unlicensed content.

key_facts.fact: SAG-AFTRA, the American Federation of Musicians, and the Writers Guild of America East and West filed a 34-page amicus brief in federal court.
The joint legal filing submitted by the unions urges a federal judge to deny OpenAI a categorical fair use exemption for training artificial intelligence models.
The unions argue that the harms of unlicensed training affect not only companies but also the individual professionals behind the creative work.

numbers.label: Length of the amicus brief in pages

quotes.text: The harms of unlicensed training fall not just on companies like the News Plaintiffs, but on the countless professionals behind the work
